citations.text: D. S. Mankowska, F. Meisel, C. Bierwirth (2014). The home health care routing and scheduling problem with interdependent services. Health Care Management Science 17(1), 15-30.
C. S. Sartori, L. S. Buriol (2020). OVIG, the instance generator the dataset's instances were generated with.

description: Instances for the daily home health care routing and scheduling problem with several service types, multiple visits and route interdependence, generated on OpenAddresses data for Porto Alegre, with lower and upper bounds and a curated selection of hard and random instances for each size.
name: HHCRSP curated instances (Kummer, 2021)

recipe.reason: The instances are keyword format text files with node positions, time windows, service durations and a travel time matrix, but the repository holds them as a very large number of separate files in size directories and publishes no archive of the curated selection, so a recipe has no single download to read; the repository's own archive holds every instance and is several gigabytes.
